art_direction: 乱菊穿蜜桃色无袖衬衫与米白短裤，走过海边咖啡露台时回眸微笑，长发掠过肩头。
composition_variation: Illustrate adult Rangiku Matsumoto in a beautiful expressive anime style, recognizable by long strawberry-blonde hair, clear blue eyes, and a warm confident smile. Reimagine her in an opaque peach sleeveless blouse with a secure closed front, relaxed ivory summer shorts, and simple sandals. She takes a lively step along a seaside cafe terrace while turning her shoulders to look back toward the viewer. One hand lightly holds a small iced citrus drink at waist level; the other sweeps a strand of hair beside her shoulder. Keep both hands fully visible and gestures compact. Peach umbrellas, pale aqua sea, and honey-colored sunlight create a lush summery palette. Show one character with natural proportions and nonsexual styling. Keep the upper quarter quiet, head near forty percent height, and essential features safely within the center crop.
